body:
Part of #11

Blocked by: #14, #17, #18, #19

## What to build

Accept v2 in the isolated Cua Linux environment and produce the new package for the #10 macOS check.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typecheck and the full test suite pass on current source.
- [ ] Standards and SPEC reviews against #11 are done and their findings resolved.
- [ ] A new package is built and installed in the isolated Paseo 0.12.0 Linux environment (never the host app), with provenance recorded.
- [ ] Performance (ADR 0003) is judged natively on real hardware: up to 500 MB, first sorted screen ≤ 2 s and each scrolled page ≤ 0.2 s. Cua VM timings and 5 GB numbers are recorded for reference only. The over-500 MB confirmation is exercised in the app.
- [ ] The UI behaviors of #11 are exercised in the real app, with screenshots: path bar, drop, icons and tooltips, scroll, row expansion, resize/fit, ⋮ menu, selection and its limit, copy, filter rules.
- [ ] #10 is updated to say macOS acceptance runs on this package.
title: v2 acceptance in Cua Linux and new package
